method: Decode Draco; select Cloth vertices with100% weight on one Foot; exclude the socks UV tile and independently reject vertices above125mm rest-worldY. Transform rest-world vertices by inverse canonical Foot rest matrix. Union every identity and both LODs, then pad0.5mm on every axis. Retain rigid laces from their separate atlas tile. Validate against actual selected vertices across180 pitch/roll/yaw rotations per model and Foot.
runtimeUse: Free-foot swing-clearance planning only. A rotated AABB is conservative and may over-lift compared with actual boots; report quantified excess. Never replace the exact complete displayed-mesh post-IK floor scan or alter planted sole anchors.
limitations: Rigid boot proxy only: excludes sock/calf, blended weights, Skin and all other materials. Rotation validation quantifies padding and empty AABB corners; it is not an animation or mobile GPU performance benchmark. Regenerate if any model geometry or bind transform changes.
rotationConvention: EulerYXZ; pitch aboutX, yaw aboutY, roll aboutZ; Foot-local metres

supportHull.paddingMethod: Transform each hull vertex by actual Foot world matrix; minimum worldY minus0.5mm is a conservative support bound in every orientation.
